description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering email subscriber search parameters within the OrangeHRM admin module. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties for enabled status and IDs, along with their getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for email subscriber search filters, allowing to specify enabled status and IDs, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets default sort field to 'emailSubscriber.name'.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is enabled or not.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status for the filter.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the list of IDs set for filtering.

methods.name: setIds
methods.description: Sets the list of IDs for filtering.
